observations: White children's bicycle with a blue saddle.
The brand name 'MILWAUKEE' is visible on the down tube in photo 0.
The bike has a rear luggage rack and a kickstand.
The front wheel has a black fender.
The frame appears to be made of steel.
The photo is taken indoors with a watermark 'www.bikebuyers.com.ng'.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a clean exterior, but internal mechanical condition is unknown.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The bike may not pedal or the drivetrain may be seized.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled through a full rotation.

risks.risk: The brakes may be worn or the cables may be frayed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the brake levers and the brake pads.

risks.risk: The tires may have thin walls or be near the end of their lifespan.
risks.proof: A photo of the tire sidewalls showing the DOT 4-digit code.

proof_requests: Video of the bike being pedaled to confirm the drivetrain works.
Close-up photo of the brake levers and pads.
Photo of the tire sidewalls to check for age and wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
